mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Reviews ( BOARD_NO, REVIEW_NAME, REVIEW_CONTENT, REVIEW_LATE, CREATED_ID, CREATED_AT, REVIEW_TIME ) VALUES ( #{boardNo}, #{reviewName}, #{reviewContent}, #{reviewRating}, #{createdId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO as reviewNo, REVIEW_NAME as reviewName, CREATED_ID as createdId FROM Reviews WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT REVIEW_NO as reviewNo, BOARD_NO as boardNo, REVIEW_NAME as reviewName, REVIEW_CONTENT as reviewContent, REVIEW_LATE as reviewRating, CREATED_ID as createdId, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM Reviews WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Reviews SET REVIEW_NAME = #{reviewName}, REVIEW_CONTENT = #{reviewContent}, REVIEW_LATE = #{reviewRating}, UPDATED_ID = #{updatedId}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
